title: Rig OTel Local Collector Configuration v0
summary: Recommended local-only collector shape for Rig Relay OTel capture and redaction before read-side ingestion.

sections.content: Use a local OpenTelemetry Collector or OTLP JSON export only. Bind receivers to localhost, export to local files, and keep remote exporters disabled by default.

sections.title: Required processors
items: memory_limiter or an equivalent local safeguard
attributes redaction or hashing for risky keys before file export

sections.content: Write raw capture files to .build/rig-relay/otel/raw/<run_id>/otel_raw.json and keep exporter output local. Remote exporters stay prohibited unless a later slice explicitly changes the policy.

sections.title: Do not enable remote export by default
sections.content: Remote vendors are not part of this slice. The collector description is local-first and read-side only.
